name: verify_notify_export
description: Verifies that the notify.mjs script exports the sendNotification function.
code: export async function evalExport(fileContent) { return { passed: fileContent.includes('export async function sendNotification') }; }

name: verify_osascript_usage
description: Verifies that osascript is actually used to trigger the notification.
code: export async function evalOsascript(fileContent) { return { passed: fileContent.includes('osascript') }; }

name: verify_cli_support
description: Verifies that the script supports direct CLI execution.
code: export async function evalCLI(fileContent) { return { passed: fileContent.includes('process.argv') }; }
